Name: Pie Collect
Overview:
You are the Pie Sweeper. Your objective is to collect as many Pies as possible. But be wary - a new Orb enemy appears every time you collect a Pie! If you hit even one Orb, you lose!

The full game of Pie Collect features Local Multiplayer, Unlockable Characters, Customizable Options, Single Player Statistics, an original soundtrack and a seriously addictive game at that!
